notes.title: [1.0.2d] You can now delete little guys on your island! + visual bugfixes
notes.notes:
[p][url="https://trello.com/c/yRxool8x/30-ability-to-delete-gourdlets"]Ability to delete gourdlets!![/url]
[url="https://trello.com/c/Wt1BP7kf/100-paintings-change-size-when-being-moved"]Paintings change size when being moved[/url]
[url="https://trello.com/c/LLxWx3IK/105-be-able-to-move-rug-even-if-there-is-furniture-on-top-of-it"]Be able to move rug even if there is furniture on top of it[/url]
[url="https://trello.com/c/6hbcpTjR/97-wall-hangings-flip-on-cam-rotate"]Wall hangings flip on cam rotate[/url]
[url="https://trello.com/c/w5cK9x4K/96-visual-glitch-on-backs-of-paintings-wall-hangings"]Visual glitch on backs of paintings / wall hangings[/url]

Deleting gourdlets has been requested since release, because if you invite too many guys over, the game starts to stutter. I wanted to spend a bunch of time testing this to make sure it doesn't corrupt existing savefiles, and I'm pretty happy with this solution![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/bd4423a194ff0ff97ccaec7ba22c74c1b6a91a11.png"][/img][/p][p]I wonder where they get sent when they're deleted?  Thanks to everyone who has reported bugs or given me feedback, and please reach out [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2FxYgv78Azwe"]in the discord[/url] if you run into problems!   Thanks for being patient with the cadence of my updates, it takes a while as this game is being developed by just 1 person! I plan to keep updating this game through development and release of Gourdlets Together, the multiplayer game that I just announced! <3 -Preethi[/p]

notes.title: First big update & first sale in Cozy Quest!
notes.notes:
Hello gourd gang,

I’m super excited to share what I’ve been working on for this next content update! The gourdlets may not have long arms (or any…) but that shouldn’t stop them from hanging up sweet wall decor!

What’s new:
💜Windows are back! Let the sun shine in on your cozy lil buildings☀️
💜Mirrors for your veggie friends so they can check themselves out 😎
💜Posters and paintings so the gourds can appreciate the fine arts at home 🏡
💜Major fix to a big save-file related bug 🐛

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/669b4582a9fcc73d38676405e44fd05955321356.gif[/img]

If you’ve not yet added Gourdlets to your library, now would be a great time as it’s on sale for the first time since launch, as part of Cozy Quest this week 🎉 Be sure to check out the other lovely titles featured in the event! 

As always, thank you for the support! We recently hit over 1000 reviews on Steam (amazing!!!) but if you haven’t left a review, that would mean a lot to me. I appreciate all the feedback and suggestions 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/a14dce84e5c9974f18c696696343eeffd2384d77.jpg[/img]

Myself and the snuggly bunnies hope you enjoy the update and have an extra cozy week!

- Preethi Vaidyanathan

notes.title: Spooky Content Update available now!
notes.notes:
Hello! 

What a crazy few weeks since launch! I’ve been very focused on squashing bugs and doing small updates to improve the experience - thank you to everyone for all your feedback and suggestions! They have been super helpful 💖 

Now onto this new update! 🎃

Well, it is the season of gourds after all…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/d98b36e238e97596cbc5930606fae7613752dc1f.gif[/img]

With this new update, you can embrace the fall season with new items and accessories for your gourds! These items are a permanent addition so you can celebrate the spooky season all year round if you wish 😁

[strike]Pumpkin[/strike] Patch Notes (Spoilers incoming!!!)

What’s new: 
[list]
[*]1 new building
[*]5 new costumes (horns, halo, pumpkin, cheese head, ghost)
[*]5 new indoor items (bed, dresser, fireplace, table, cauldron)
[*]3 new outdoor items (scarecrow, jack-o-lantern, pumpkin)
[*]3 new indoor floors
[*] Twitch integration: when you reload a savefile in twitch, chat members' gourdlets persist [url=https://trello.com/c/C6EtXtWi/31-twitch-integration-replaces-gourdlets?filter=*](bug tracker link)[/url]
[*] Fixes a bug where if you place a building, move it, then place another building on that spot, the new building gets the old interior. [url=https://trello.com/c/hsLI0Heb/8-issues-with-building-interiors-deleting-buildings?filter=*](bug tracker link - note this link contains a bunch of bug, only some of which are fixed by this change)[/url]
[/list]

Thank you all for your support! As always you can [url=https://discord.gg/T7zuwWeKRS]join our Discord server here[/url] to share your autmnal islands with me 🍂 Hope you love the update and enjoy halloween as much as Cinny and Poppy do :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/d83a93b45594d7742fb6e13f33f68203eda8d006.jpg[/img]


- Preethi Vaidyanathan

notes.title: Release Date Reveal!!!
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

I am super excited to be writing to you all today, as I have BIG NEWS…

Gourdlets can be yours on August 15th!! 🎉

It's so cool to be able to finally say that! Over the last couple months I’ve made some really exciting additions to the game, like a new ‘town ledger’ feature which includes names and photos of all your gourdy residents, you can now watch the world you’ve created change with the seasons, and fill your island with tons of items and activities to keep your gourdlets happy (including a Ferris Wheel whaaat?!)💜

[previewyoutube=_z7VXzfbifU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Thank you!![/b]

I want to say a big big thank you to everyone who has played the demo, sent feedback and expressed their interest in my first ever game, it’s all contributed so much to the process, which I hope you’ll be able to see when you play. I’m so excited to finally bring the full game to you all! If you’re new here, welcome 💜 Hope you like adorable little vegetable folks…!

Thanks for reading and see you on the 15th!

- Preethi Vaidyanathan

notes.title: Gourdlets Release Window Reveal & New Demo drop!
notes.notes:
Hello Gourd community!

I’m so excited to share this news with you ✨ It’s been hard to keep this one to myself, but I can finally tell you that Gourdlets will be yours this SUMMER!! It feels good to get that off my chest. Keep your eyes peeled for more updates on this 💜
[u][b]
Demo update![/b][/u]

In preparation for the Cozy & Family Friendly Steam event (not to mention the upcoming Steam Next Fest in June), I have been perfecting every cute and goofy corner of this game to bring you the best new Demo that I can, which is available for you to play for free right now! There’s heaps of new stuff in there, and your Gourdlets can now sleep, do laundry and make toast, among many other things! It’s a tricky balance trying to give you plenty to play and create with, whilst wanting to hold back plenty of cool stuff for the full release, but hopefully I’ve managed that. I’ll most likely be giving the demo another update in a couple of weeks ahead of the Next Fest too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/41b26fd359c7faec4f34f8d6581f0aa09848115a.gif[/img]

A cool new feature I’m excited for you to try is ‘idle window mode’! This is where the gourdlets can keep playing at the bottom (or side) of your screen while you dip in and out, browsing the internet or doing important tasks as you go 🙂 It’s very much inspired by the fantastic Rusty’s Retirement by Mister Morris Games, which I’m a huge fan of - check it out if you haven’t already!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/c4ff2784cd19b2216fc4320bd6b84ce833a00319.gif[/img]

I can’t wait to see what you all come up with, and if you do have any feedback you can [url=https://discord.gg/T7zuwWeKRS]join our Discord server here[/url]. I will try my best to take everything on [strike]gourd[/strike] board!


Enjoy and speak soon.

- Preethi Vaidyanathan

notes.title: April Development update!
notes.notes:
Hello Gourdlet friends!

Now that it’s starting to get warm enough to venture outside, I thought this would be a good time to take tentative steps out of my solo development cave and give a little update on what I’ve been working on, which recently, has been tons and tons of drawing. 

If you happened to catch me at GDC & Day of the Devs then maybe you got a sneak peek at some of the new things I’m working on! Thank you everyone who took the time to say hello! 

I can’t wait to share more news soon but until then… I thought it would be fun to dig up some old pictures and show you how the drawings have evolved. 

[h2]Behind the Scenes: Home Sweet Home![/h2]

Here is the original house artwork that I drew in June 2022, when Gourdlets didn’t have a name yet and was just a hobby that I would spend a few hours on each weekend. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/fb055b4024aeea9f2cf218dffe3e54efa343d8e1.png[/img]

And then here it was in November 2022, a week before I put up the Steam page and Gourdlets became slightly more real. I realized that not all pixel art needs a thick dark border! With enough visual trickery in the game, this makes things look slightly more 3D. It’s a big compliment when someone is surprised to hear that all of the art in the game is just flat PNG images.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/67a0c8b722b5bd675956b21d0a6415901fd048e2.png[/img]

And then here is what I came up with this past February, at which point I had been seriously working on Gourdlets for a full year, and was fully in the grips of insanity- dreaming in lines of code, losing all objectivity, and spending 2 hours moving around the pixels on an individual roof shingle in a way that no one but me could possibly notice. But in a fun way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/fa335755cbc3b247c6d0d959519a0bef7f65af6f.png[/img]

I’ve also been hard at work on programmatically generating many colors of each object- this is really fun because I just have to draw the 1 base item, and then can spend the next 15 hours a normal amount of time coming up with a color palette, and then my code spits out all the recolored artwork. I’m also working on updating the UI like crazy to make it look more organized, here’s a sneak peek at what I have so far:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/ec277b45a0a695f0418647186bb0899fd5972058.jpg[/img]

Plus a sneak peek at some of the other buildings! There are just a few houses in the current Steam demo, but now I have 8 base houses x 8 colors = 64 unique house buildings. Math!

And here they are on display with a few other new items… 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/15e061c42302c7957410b96496f95d14d271dce5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Cool houses! Now what?[/h2]

Now it’s time for me to get back to drawing a ton more objects, and answering tricky questions like: do gourdlets need toasters??????

Thank you so much for reading this and supporting the development of Gourdlets! Here is your reward: an important picture of Cinny and Poppy eating salad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/29c562e658470afa45bc3d36aa29e675aeb0ac6a.jpg[/img]

- Preethi Vaidyanathan

notes.title: 🏡 Demo Update: Interior decorating
notes.notes:
Hello Gourdlets fans!

I'm Preethi Vaidyanathan, developer of Gourdlets. Welcome to my first steam update :)

Big news! I have just added a brand new feature to Gourdlets, the cozy city builder - interior decorating! Now, you can enter buildings and decorate them to your heart's content. This new feature adds a whole new level of personalization to the game and allows you to create unique spaces that truly feel like your own.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/73ea7a98b58af3a8e3cb6442289592af39a5a4df.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43184551/587d24777fb24d8cc231ac0c0e1811ab3467d651.png[/img]

To give you a taste of what's possible with this new feature, I have added items that let you create a cozy cafe to the demo. Now, your gourdlets can browse dessert stands, play chess, and drink tea while surrounded by delightful decor. But that's just the beginning! I am planning to add even more items for houses, libraries, shops, and more. With each new addition, you'll have even more options for customizing your spaces and making them uniquely yours.

I am thrilled to see how players will use this new feature to express their creativity and make the game world their own. I can't wait to hear your feedback as you explore all the possibilities of interior decorating in the coziest city builder.

Don't forget to [url=http://s.team/a/2013730]wishlist[/url], and [url=discord.gg/xYgv78Azwe]join the Discord[/url], where you can suggest new items and interactions for me to add to the game. I love hearing from our players and value your input as I continue to develop Gourdlets. Thank you for playing, and happy decorating!

-Preethi
